detail: Train boundary=2018-11-26 00:00:00-08:00, validation boundary=2019-01-07 00:00:00-08:00; boundaries are Monday 00:00 local time.
Deep-model normalization statistics are fit using rows before the train boundary only; tree models use no scaler.
Missing sensor/load values use causal forward-fill only plus fixed 0.0 for leading gaps; no interpolation, backfill, or test-set statistics.
Historical averages use occupied labels before train boundary only.
Rolling occupancy/count features are shifted and exclude the current/future labels: arr[anchor-window:anchor].
Known future inputs are calendar/time only; sensor features are issue-time observations repeated across horizon.
HVAC, lighting, MELS, and total south electricity are excluded from predictors and used only for opportunity calculation.
